say:2:1041407001:1.text: Ugh, I got so much mud on me... I think I'll take a bath.
say:2:1041407001:1.source_cn: 唔，身上粘了好多泥巴……漫漫想洗澡了。

choice_prompt:3:1041407001.text: Ugh, I got so much mud on me... I think I'll take a bath.

say:4:1041407002:1.text: W-water?! No way, Magister! That's super dangerous... it'll make my fur wet!
say:4:1041407002:1.source_cn: 为、为什么要热水！水很危险哇，主人！会把毛毛弄湿的！
say:4:1041407002:1.male: W-water?! No way, Magister! That's super dangerous... it'll make my fur wet!
say:4:1041407002:1.female: W-water?! No way, Magister! That's super dangerous... it'll make my fur wet!

say:5:1041407003:1.text: Water is very dangerous. It can make your joints rust.
say:5:1041407003:1.source_cn: 水，非常危险，会让关节生锈。

choice_prompt:6:1041407003.text: Water is very dangerous. It can make your joints rust.
choice_prompt:6:1041407003.source_cn: 水，非常危险，会让关节生锈。

say:7:1041407004:1.text: Of course! I'm gonna have a nice long soak in some sand. It'll make my fur so nice and fluffy!
say:7:1041407004:1.source_cn: 可是洗澡，用沙子洗不是更好吗？可以把毛洗得很松散！

say:8:1041407005:1.text: On the other hand, bathing with water is risky; it's easy to catch a cold, and it'll be super hard to dry! Your poor fur will never look the same!!
say:8:1041407005:1.source_cn: 用水很容易着凉，而且很难干吧？不止如此，被水粘过的皮肤...

say:9:1041407006:1.text: I can't believe this... I know you lost your memories, but to think that you even forgot basic knowledge like this? My poor Magister...
say:9:1041407006:1.source_cn: 真是的，主人失忆以后，连生活常识都没有了……

say:11:1041407007:1.text: Yes, I agree. The way of familiars doesn't apply to others.
say:11:1041407007:1.source_cn: 嗯，赞同。使魔的方式并不适用，他人。

say:12:1041407008:1.text: Oil, on the other hand, is safe and very good for your body.
say:12:1041407008:1.source_cn: 油，安全，又可以带走灰尘，很有好处。
